findings.finding: Atoms explicitly selected for removal and stale hydrogens could incorrectly reject a retained ligand repair as clashing.
findings.resolution: Worker supplies retained heavy-atom environment indices; removed residues, removed waters and old hydrogens are omitted while coordinating waters are retained.

findings.finding: Newly supported named ions were absent from viewer category recognition; MDTraj also recognizes CAL as protein-like.
findings.resolution: Storage shares the verified ion registry and gives matching one-atom elemental identity precedence, while multiatom compounds, wrong elements and unsupported states remain ligands.
